comments.text: Merging the submitted provider fields on top of the stored config matched by provider name (not by index) correctly preserves write-only client secrets when providers are added, reordered or edited, and new providers/explicit secrets still take effect. Tests cover both the core merge and the API flow. Nits: typos in comments ("standrad", "parially", "reassigne"), and the inner loop variable `plain` shadows the outer `plain` struct, which is legal but confusing; consider renaming.
